os_auth_url.description: The OpenStack Identity endpoint URL (e.g., keystone v3).

os_region_name.description: The OpenStack region to query metrics from.

os_password.description: Password for OpenStack authentication (use application credentials in production).

os_user_domain_name.description: User's domain name (required for v3 auth).

os_project_domain_name.description: Project's domain name (required for v3 auth).

os_application_credential_secret.description: Secret for the application credential (used with name or ID).

os_interface.description: Endpoint interface to use (public, internal, or admin).

exporter_listen_address.description: IP address to bind the exporter's HTTP server to.

exporter_port.description: Port on which the exporter exposes metrics.

exporter_insecure_skip_verify.description: Skip TLS certificate verification for OpenStack APIs (use only in trusted environments).

collectors.description: Enable or disable specific OpenStack resource collectors. Each key is a collector name; true enables it.

log_level.description: Logging verbosity level (debug, info, warn, error, etc.).

exclude_services.description: List of OpenStack service types to exclude (e.g., ['baremetal', 'volumev3']).

tls_cert_file.description: Path to TLS certificate file for HTTPS endpoint (optional).

tls_key_file.description: Path to TLS private key file for HTTPS endpoint (optional).

metrics_path_prefix.description: Prefix to prepend to all exported metric names.
